response.justification: The candidate is an experienced, versatile senior full-stack engineer with strong fundamentals, some high-scale distributed systems exposure (low-latency services handling millions of requests per second), and recent AI-tooling work. However, the resume shows no evidence of experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering — the core of this role — and no demonstrated Principal-level scope such as leading multi-team, multi-workstream initiatives or building systemic platforms adopted across organizations.
strengths: 15+ years of engineering experience across many languages and stacks, including high-scale, low-latency microservices
Recent hands-on AI-agent infrastructure and developer-tooling work (MCP code generators, agentic workflows)
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions, teaching and community workshops
concerns: No demonstrated experience with experimentation systems, A/B testing, feature flighting, or growth measurement
Career trajectory is senior IC on product teams, not Principal-level architecture leadership across teams and products
Limited evidence of data/statistical analysis, metrics design, or telemetry platform ownership

key_factors.factor: Strong engineering fundamentals and scale experience
